```artifact
Feature: Doctor and Chemist/Lab Management

  Scenario Outline: Add a new Doctor
    Given a system is running
    When a new Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" is added
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | Dr. John| 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology |
      | Dr. Jane| 35  | F   | DO            | 5          | Pediatrics |

  Scenario Outline: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given a system is running
    When a new Chemist or Lab with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>" is added
    Then the Chemist or Lab should be added successfully
    Examples:
      | name    | pincode |
      | Chemist | 12345   |
      | Lab     | 12345   |

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Doctor
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" exists
    When the Doctor's details are viewed
    Then the Doctor's details should be displayed correctly
    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | Dr. John| 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Chemist or Lab
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" exists
    When the Chemist or Lab's details are viewed
    Then the Chemist or Lab's details should be displayed correctly
    Examples:
      | name    | pincode |
      | Chemist | 12345   |
      | Lab     | 12345   |

  Scenario Outline: Delete the Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" exists
    And no new Patient Consultation Request is pending for the Doctor
    When the Doctor is deleted
    Then the Doctor should be deleted successfully
    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | Dr. John| 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: Delete the Chemist / Lab Details
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" exists
    And no new Prescription is pending for the Chemist or Lab
    When the Chemist or Lab is deleted
    Then the Chemist or Lab should be deleted successfully
    Examples:
      | name    | pincode |
      | Chemist | 12345   |
      | Lab     | 12345   |

  Scenario Outline: Attempt to add a duplicate Doctor
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" exists
    When a new Doctor with the same name, age, sex, qualification, experience, and speciality is added
    Then an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed
    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality | error_message |
      | Dr. John| 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology | Duplicate doctor |

  Scenario Outline: Attempt to add a duplicate Chemist or Lab
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" exists
    When a new Chemist or Lab with the same name and pincode is added
    Then an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed
    Examples:
      | name    | pincode | error_message |
      | Chemist | 12345   | Duplicate Chemist or Lab |

  Scenario Outline: Attempt to update the speciality of a Doctor
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" exists
    When the Doctor's speciality is updated to "<new_speciality>"
    Then an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed
    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality | new_speciality | error_message |
      | Dr. John| 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology | Pediatrics     | Forbidden update |

  Scenario Outline: Attempt to update the pincode of a Chemist or Lab
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" exists
    When the Chemist or Lab's pincode is updated to "<new_pincode>"
    Then an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed
    Examples:
      | name    | pincode | new_pincode | error_message |
      | Chemist | 12345   | 12346       | Forbidden update |

  Scenario Outline: Attempt to delete a Doctor with pending Patient Consultation Requests
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", and speciality "<speciality>" exists
    And a new Patient Consultation Request is pending for the Doctor
    When the Doctor is deleted
    Then an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed
    Examples:
      | name    | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality | error_message |
      | Dr. John| 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology | Pending requests |

  Scenario Outline: Attempt to delete a Chemist or Lab with pending Prescriptions
    Given a Chemist or Lab with name "<name>" and pincode "<pincode>" exists
    And a new Prescription is pending for the Chemist or Lab
    When the Chemist or Lab is deleted
    Then an error message "<error_message>" should be displayed
    Examples:
      | name    | pincode | error_message |
      | Chemist | 12345   | Pending prescriptions |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary test for age
    Given a system is running
    When a new Doctor with age "<age>" is added
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    Examples:
      | age |
      | 20  |
      | 60  |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary test for experience
    Given a system is running
    When a new Doctor with experience "<experience>" is added
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    Examples:
      | experience |
      | 0          |
      | 30         |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary test for pincode
    Given a system is running
    When a new Chemist or Lab with pincode "<pincode>" is added
    Then the Chemist or Lab should be added successfully
    Examples:
      | pincode |
      | 10000   |
      | 99999   |
```
